sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Amazing grace how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I once was lost but now am found
Was blind but now I see

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear
And grace my fears relieved

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Through many dangers, toils and snares
I have already come

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far
And grace will lead me home

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
When we've been there ten thousand years
Bright shining as the sun

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we'd first begun

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Holy, holy, holy! Merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Holy, holy, holy! All the saints adore Thee
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Cherubim and seraphim falling down before Thee
Which wert, and art, and evermore shalt be

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Holy, holy, holy! Though the darkness hide Thee
Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee
Perfect in power, in love, and purity

songs.title: It Is Well With My Soul
songs.author: Horatio Spafford

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
When peace like a river attendeth my way
When sorrows like sea billows roll

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Whatever my lot, Thou hast taught me to say
It is well, it is well with my soul

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
It is well (it is well)
With my soul (with my soul)

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text: It is well, it is well with my soul

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Though Satan should buffet, though trials should come
Let this blest assurance control

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
That Christ hath regarded my helpless estate
And hath shed His own blood for my soul

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
And Lord, haste the day when the faith shall be sight
The clouds be rolled back as a scroll

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
The trump shall resound, and the Lord shall descend
Even so, it is well with my soul

songs.title: Be Thou My Vision
songs.author: Ancient Irish Hymn (tr. Mary E. Byrne)

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Be Thou my Vision, O Lord of my heart
Naught be all else to me, save that Thou art

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Thou my best Thought, by day or by night
Waking or sleeping, Thy presence my light

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Be Thou my Wisdom, and Thou my true Word
I ever with Thee and Thou with me, Lord

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Thou my great Father, I Thy true son
Thou in me dwelling, and I with Thee one

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
High King of Heaven, my victory won
May I reach Heaven's joys, O bright Heaven's Sun!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Heart of my own heart, whatever befall
Still be my Vision, O Ruler of all

songs.title: Come Thou Fount of Every Blessing
songs.author: Robert Robinson

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Come, Thou Fount of every blessing
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Streams of mercy, never ceasing
Call for songs of loudest praise

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Here I raise my Ebenezer
Hither by Thy help I'm come

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
And I hope, by Thy good pleasure
Safely to arrive at home

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Let Thy goodness, like a fetter
Bind my wandering heart to Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
O what a foretaste of glory divine!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Heir of salvation, purchase of God
Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
This is my story, this is my song
Praising my Savior all the day long

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
This is my story, this is my song
Praising my Savior all the day long

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Perfect submission, all is at rest
I in my Savior am happy and blest

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Watching and waiting, looking above
Filled with His goodness, lost in His love

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me
Let me hide myself in Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Let the water and the blood
From Thy wounded side which flowed

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Be of sin the double cure
Save from wrath and make me pure

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Nothing in my hand I bring
Simply to Thy cross I cling

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Naked, come to Thee for dress
Helpless, look to Thee for grace

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Foul, I to the fountain fly
Wash me, Savior, or I die

songs.title: All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
songs.author: Edward Perronet

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Let angels prostrate fall

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Bring forth the royal diadem
And crown Him Lord of all

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Let every kindred, every tribe
On this terrestrial ball

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
To Him all majesty ascribe
And crown Him Lord of all

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
We'll join the everlasting song
And crown Him Lord of all

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Crown Him with many crowns
The Lamb upon His throne

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Hark! how the heavenly anthem drowns
All music but its own

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Awake, my soul, and sing
Of Him who died for thee

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
And hail Him as thy matchless King
Through all eternity

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Fairest Lord Jesus, Ruler of all nature
O Thou of God and man the Son

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Thee will I cherish, Thee will I honor
Thou, my soul's glory, joy, and crown

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Fair are the meadows, fairer still the woodlands
Robed in the blooming garb of spring

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Jesus is fairer, Jesus is purer
Who makes the woeful heart to sing

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Joy to the world, the Lord is come!
Let earth receive her King

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Let every heart prepare Him room
And heaven and nature sing

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
He rules the world with truth and grace
And makes the nations prove

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
The glories of His righteousness
And wonders of His love

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Love divine, all loves excelling
Joy of heaven, to earth come down

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling
All Thy faithful mercies crown

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Finish, then, Thy new creation
Pure and spotless let us be

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Let us see Thy great salvation
Perfectly restored in Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!
E'en though it be a cross that raiseth me

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Still all my song shall be
Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
There let the way appear, steps unto heaven
All that Thou sendest me, in mercy given

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Angels to beckon me
Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

songs.title: O For a Thousand Tongues to Sing
songs.author: Charles Wesley

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O for a thousand tongues to sing
My great Redeemer's praise

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
The glories of my God and King
The triumphs of His grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
My gracious Master and my God
Assist me to proclaim

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
To spread through all the earth abroad
The honors of Thy name

songs.title: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
songs.author: Joachim Neander (tr. Catherine Winkworth)

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All ye who hear, now to His temple draw near
Join me in glad adoration!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Praise to the Lord, who o'er all things so wondrously reigneth
Shelters thee under His wings, yea, so gently sustaineth

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Hast thou not seen how thy desires e'er have been
Granted in what He ordaineth?

songs.title: Take My Life and Let It Be
songs.author: Frances Ridley Havergal

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Take my life and let it be
Consecrated, Lord, to Thee

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Take my moments and my days
Let them flow in ceaseless praise

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Take my silver and my gold
Not a mite would I withhold

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Take my intellect and use
Every power as Thou shalt choose

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
The Church's one foundation
Is Jesus Christ her Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
She is His new creation
By water and the Word

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Elect from every nation
Yet one o'er all the earth

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Her charter of salvation
One Lord, one faith, one birth

songs.title: A Mighty Fortress Is Our God
songs.author: Martin Luther (tr. Frederick H. Hedge)

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
A mighty fortress is our God
A bulwark never failing

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Our helper He, amid the flood
Of mortal ills prevailing

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
That word above all earthly powers
No thanks to them, abideth

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
The Spirit and the gifts are ours
Through Him who with us sideth

songs.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus
songs.author: Joseph M. Scriven

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
What a Friend we have in Jesus
All our sins and griefs to bear!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
We should never be discouraged
Take it to the Lord in prayer

songs.title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross
songs.author: Isaac Watts

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of glory died

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
My richest gain I count but loss
And pour contempt on all my pride

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Were the whole realm of nature mine
That were a present far too small

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Love so amazing, so divine
Demands my soul, my life, my all

songs.title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today
songs.author: Charles Wesley

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Christ the Lord is risen today, Alleluia!
Sons of men and angels say, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Raise your joys and triumphs high, Alleluia!
Sing, ye heavens, and earth reply, Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Lives again our glorious King, Alleluia!
Where, O death, is now thy sting? Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Once He died our souls to save, Alleluia!
Where's thy victory, boasting grave? Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Abide with me; fast falls the eventide
The darkness deepens; Lord, with me abide!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
When other helpers fail and comforts flee
Help of the helpless, O abide with me

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I need Thy presence every passing hour
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's power?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Who, like Thyself, my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, Lord, abide with me
